subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the town of Madrasapatnam, which later expanded and developed into modern-day Chennai, purchased by the East India Company (EIC) from local kings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1639**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The town of Madrasapatnam, which later evolved into modern-day Chennai, was purchased by the **East India Company (EIC)** in the year 1639.
 
• The purchase was facilitated by Francis Day, who was an agent of the East India Company, and the land was acquired from the local Nayak rulers of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• The land was acquired to establish a trading post and fortification, which eventually became known as **Fort St. George**.
 
• Fort St. George, established in 1644, became the first major English settlement in India and played a pivotal role in the expansion of British influence in the region.
 
• Chennai, originally Madrasapatnam, grew around Fort St. George and became a significant administrative and commercial hub for the British in southern India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1690**

 
 
• In 1690, Job Charnock of the East India Company established a settlement in Bengal, which eventually developed into the city of Kolkata (formerly Calcutta).
 
• It marked the beginning of British influence in the Bengal region and the establishment of another major administrative hub of the British Empire in India.
 
 
 
• **1620**
 
 
• In 1620, the British East India Company set up a factory at Masulipatnam (Machilipatnam) on the Coromandel Coast, which was one of their earliest trading posts in India.
 
• Masulipatnam played a critical role in the early trade of textiles and spices between India and Europe.
 
 
 
• **1658**
 
 
• 1658 marks the period during which the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb seized the throne after defeating his brothers in the war of succession.
 
• This year is significant in Indian history for the beginning of Aurangzeb's reign, which marked the expansion of the Mughal Empire to its largest territorial extent.
